description: This file implements the PlacementService class in the Orleans.Runtime.Placement namespace. It is responsible for placement decisions of grains, address message routing, and managing placement workers. The class interacts with various resolvers, strategies, and the grain locator to orchestrate grain placement and address resolution.

classes.name: PlacementService
classes.description: Provides placement logic for grains, including address resolution, placement strategies, and managing placement workers for concurrent message handling.

classes.name: PlacementService.PlacementWorker
classes.description: Handles concurrent placement work items, processing address messages asynchronously and managing placement requests.

classes.name: PlacementService.GrainPlacementWorkItem
classes.description: Represents an in-progress placement work with queued messages and a task for the resulting silo address.

methods.name: AddressMessage
methods.description: Routes a message to its target grain, performing lookup or caching as needed.

methods.name: SetMessageTargetPlacement
methods.description: Sets the target silo address for a message.

methods.name: GetCompatibleSilos
methods.description: Returns silos compatible with a given placement target, considering filtering strategies and interface versions.

methods.name: AllActiveSilos
methods.description: Retrieves all active silos, defaulting to local silo if none are known.

methods.name: GetCompatibleSilosWithVersions
methods.description: Gets silos compatible with a given placement target, grouped by interface version.

methods.name: CachedAddressIsValid
methods.description: Checks if the cached grain address is still valid for a message.

methods.name: PlaceGrainAsync
methods.description: Places a grain asynchronously without considering its current location.
